claim.quote: This first direct observation of parity nonconservation in Moller scattering leads to a measurement of the electron's weak charge at low energy Q^e_W = -0.053 +/- 0.011.

key_value_text.value: A_PV = -175 +- 30 (stat) +- 20 (syst) ppb; electron weak charge Q_W^e = -0.053 +- 0.011

name: E158: first observation of parity nonconservation in Moller scattering

summary.plain: E158 saw, for the first time, the tiny left-right difference in how polarised electrons scatter from other electrons, a purely leptonic effect of the weak force that violates mirror symmetry. It gave the electron's weak charge, in line with the Standard Model.
summary.technical: A_PV = -175 +- 30 stat +- 20 syst ppb in fixed-target e-e (Moller) scattering, giving the electron's weak charge at low energy Q_W^e = -0.053 +- 0.011 and sin^2 theta_W(M_Z) (MSbar) = 0.2293 +- 0.0024 stat +- 0.0016 syst +- 0.0006 theory, consistent with the Standard Model.

title: Observation of Parity Nonconservation in Moller Scattering
why_it_matters: First direct observation of parity nonconservation in Moller scattering and a low-energy measurement of the electron's weak charge.
